about: The room page's Lost in Translation (the five subscriptions with the trace of the player's step, the id of the task the player put away, the three mutations, starting a game, sending a step, and the seconds of the draw timer) to hooks/games/use-lost-in-translation.ts, and what the page holds of Word Rush (its subscription, its two mutations and starting a lobby) to hooks/games/use-word-rush-starter.ts. The replay sheet's open state and the effect that opens it stay in the page. The table holds for the tree of the commit that added it (git log --diff-filter=A -- scripts/step6/tables/web-lit-wordrush-hooks.json): later moves take more lines out of the page. From the repo root, with that commit checked out in <folder>: node scripts/step6/web-move-check.mjs scripts/step6/tables/web-lit-wordrush-hooks.json --root <folder> --strict-indent, and node scripts/step6/hook-order.mjs "apps/web/app/room/[roomId]/page.tsx" --root <folder> --base 461c240 --allow scripts/step6/tables/web-lit-wordrush-hooks.hooks.json --strict

apps/web/app/room/[roomId]/page.tsx: const { dismissedGameStepId, setDismissedGameStepId, activeGameSession, myActiveStep, latestGameSession, gameReplay, gameStatus, activeTimerSeconds, cancelGameMutation, handleStartGame, handleSubmitGameStep } = useLostInTranslation({ roomId, participantId, setShowGamePicker });
const { wordRushGame, cancelWordRush, handleStartWordRush } = useWordRushStarter({ roomId, participantId, setShowGamePicker, cancelGameMutation });
